lessons: Multisampled offscreen color requires matching depth renderbuffer; explicit single-sample depth texture produces incomplete framebuffer.
Custom uColor repeats known E05J Pixi mesh-uniform collision. Require namespace audit in repaired adapter.
Instrumented getError consumes errors; zero finalGL in diagnostic is not a pass when traces contain failures.
Mask allocation must include MSAA color/depth plus resolve targets; initial16bytes-per-pixel arithmetic is a lower bound only.
